claims.text: Each listed month is the calculated general-aviation share of tower operations at SCF, defined as {F1.definition}.
The ordinary least-squares slope of the monthly series over {F37.period} is {F37}.
The September 2026 share minus the October 2023 share is {F39}.

Read in order, the share is lower in December 2024 ({F15}) and March 2025 ({F18}) than in October 2023 ({F1}), higher in September 2025 ({F24}) than in March 2025, and lower in September 2026 ({F36}) than in September 2025.
Within this window, October 2023 is the highest monthly share and September 2026 is the lowest.

assumptions: SDL is bound to Scottsdale Airport in Phoenix, AZ, whose current code is SCF. The resolver describes SDL as a historical or alternate code for that single airport.
limitations: ATADS counts operations at towered airports during tower hours and includes all user classes. Operations outside tower hours are not in this series.
The share can move because general-aviation operations change, because other user classes change, or both. These results do not separate those drivers.
Unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, and profitability are not measured here.
The linear slope includes seasonality and is descriptive only. It is not a seasonally adjusted trend and not a forecast.

The figure {F39} is the arithmetic difference of the two monthly shares. The figure {F38} is the relative change for the last month versus the same month one year earlier. Neither figure is a valuation or a screening rank.
